profileHeader.headline: Recent Communications graduate seeking an entry-level marketing or content role, leveraging customer empathy and writing skills.

dhpView.personalStory: Graduated 18 months ago with a Bachelor of Communications from UTS. Currently working in hospitality while actively seeking entry-level marketing and content roles. Has applied for over 40 positions, receiving limited responses. Jordan feels disconnected from the job market and is eager to demonstrate writing, customer empathy, and project thinking skills in a dedicated marketing or content role.

layers.label: Workplace collaboration

layers.label: AI Literacy & Fluency
